name: Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD 3000S
description: A wire-free, all-wheel-drive robotic mower from Mammotion's LUBA 3 line, combining 360° LiDAR, cloud-based RTK correction, and dual-camera AI vision for centimeter-level navigation. Genuine 4WD rated for 80% grade slopes. Launched at CES 2026.

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: Core NetRTK/nav free via WiFi; cellular remote access is a paid add-on ($19.90/3mo or $49.90/yr) after free trial period

sourcing: Verified against Mammotion's own official product/blog pages (mammotion.com, us.mammotion.com) and a TechRadar review. Runtime-per-charge figures differ between Mammotion's own site (215 min) and TechRadar's tested result (175 min) — both are reported above rather than picking one. Price also differs by source ($2,799 official vs. $2,399 in the TechRadar review); confirm current price before buying. This is a brand-new model announced at CES 2026, so longer-term reliability data isn't yet available.

pricing.summary: Mammotion's official US site lists the LUBA 3 AWD 3000 at **$2,799**. A TechRadar review cited **$2,399** — likely a launch-promo or bundle price difference around the CES 2026 debut — so treat this as a discrepancy to double-check at checkout rather than a fixed number.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: The LUBA 3 AWD ships in 1500/3000/5000 coverage tiers, each in "S" (Standard) and "H" (High) cutting-height variants. Navigation uses Mammotion's "Tri-Fusion" stack: 360° LiDAR (up to 70m range), cloud-based NetRTK correction (no physical base station), and dual-camera AI vision claiming ±1cm accuracy. Four-wheel independent drive is rated for 80% grade slopes, earning it the nickname "the Slope King."

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Mammotion's claim that the LUBA 3 AWD's four independently driven wheels handle steep terrain is independently verified: TechRadar's review confirmed it manages 80%-grade slopes, nicknaming it "the Slope King." That same review measured runtime at 175 minutes per charge versus the 215 minutes listed on Mammotion's own site.

firmwareCommunity.note: Mammotion LUBA 3 AWD 3000S has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
